::: {.callout-important}
## Before your first commit

Run `quarto render` once in this folder. The first render creates the
`.gitignore` and `README.md` files, and `.gitignore` keeps fitted models
and other large files out of git. Then delete this box.
:::

This site hosts the supplemental analysis reports, code, and data for:

## Archived Version

A frozen, citable copy of these materials is archived on Zenodo. Add the
DOI here after the first GitHub release.
